exact: viral exit by cytolysis via suppression of host peptidoglycan biosynthetic process
viral release by cytolysis via suppression of host peptidoglycan biosynthetic process
related: cytolysis by virus via suppression of host peptidoglycan biosynthetic process

definition: The dissemination of mature viral particles from a host cell, caused by a virus stopping, preventing, or reducing peptidoglycan biosynthesis in the host organism. Peptidoglycans are any of a class of glycoconjugates found in bacterial cell walls.
label: viral release via suppression of host peptidoglycan biosynthetic process
